reviews.title: Damb, this thing is FAST!
reviews.comment: I build my own systems, and have now for about 20 years.  If you haven't yet, and are about to, welcome aboard what will be a very satisfying hobby/job.  The last two were Intel builds, my previous being an i7 4790. Yeah, seven years ago.  I had some money, and a wife who agreed the upgrade was necessary, and off we went.  So good to meet the UPS man at the door, or in the front yard for several days in a row.  Neighbors were jealous.  It was just as much as a blink of yer eye's worth of effort to install this CPU.  It really felt weighty and substantial in the figglers.  The build went off without a hitch, and she's running now.  Before, the Bluestacks launch would take  about 30 seconds to load. Now???? It's done in about 5.8 seconds!  That's fast!  I see the differences in speed on several fronts, and it's very nice to command.  Thank you, Intel, for another winner in the CPU dept.

reviews.title: So far so good.
reviews.comment: Leaving out all of the typical troubleshooting you would normally do with a custom build, the only real problem I had was windows selecting a balanced power profile automatically on startup after I got everything put together and running. The balanced power profile was causing the 10700kf to perform sporadically in my recording software (Studio One 5 Pro) and led to power throttling in the Intel extreme tuning utility. Deleting the balanced profile so that windows was forced to use high performance or extreme performance seemed to fix the issue. So far I haven't been able to overload the cpu in any applications. Overclocked to a solid 5.0ghz. Very happy with the performance I get out of this cpu.
reviews.author: Jordan
